# Vercel AI Gateway Billing Dispute — Summary

**Incident:** On **Jul 8, 2026**, anomalous charges appeared on [REDACTED EMAIL]'s Vercel account. Initial theory (leaked API key or account compromise) was ruled out when forensics showed the charge pattern matched an automated billing bug, not human or API-driven spending.

**Evidence & Diagnosis:**
- **9 "AI Gateway Credits" invoices in an 18-minute burst** (~2:50 PM UTC, stopped ~3:00 PM)
- **Seven $20 charges within 28 seconds** (timestamps: 21:50:11–21:50:39 UTC)
- Two additional $21.62 charges ~17 minutes later
- **Total: $183.24** ($180 in credits)
- Pattern signature: identical charges at near-instantaneous intervals; consistent with automated retry/webhook loop, not manual or API key spending

**Action Taken:**
Dispute filed with Vercel Support on **Jul 8, 2026, ~6:09 PM**, routed through [REDACTED EMAIL]'s account dashboard. Submission included exact charge count and UTC timestamps as evidence of erroneous duplicate charges, with request for reversal.

**Context:** User confirmed no Stella backend usage of Vercel AI Gateway (OpenRouter used instead), and no team members on solo account ruled out third-party spending theories.
